method_detail: Per-query top-k=30 pooling with thenlper/gte-small (mean-pool + L2, cosine, seed 13, self-excluded) over the 2229-doc corpus; all 150x30=4500 (query, candidate) pairs graded 0-3 by qwen2.5:7b-instruct (local ollama, 0-egress) under the byte-identical S13/S14 anti-code-strict-v2 config. PRIMARY relevant set = graded qrels >= 1 AFTER the freeze demotion rule (see freeze_decision). Within-A only; NOT absolute-comparable to B native.
annotator: qwen2.5:7b-instruct (LLM judge, single model) + gemma2:9b 2nd-judge corroboration + blind operator human adjudication (n=16, condition-2 tie-breaker)

source.citation: Pereira 2022, Federal Inst. Santa Catarina (BR), 'Classification of IT Support Tickets'

judge.runtime: local ollama (0-egress; daemon started for the build and killed after)

second_judge.family_note: different model family from qwen (9B), pulled as a public-model download (network-IN, not A egress)
second_judge.capability_probe: 6/6 scorable on the 7 known-answer S13 control pairs (above the >=5/7 floor -> no escalation); a competent independent grader
second_judge.sample: 149-pair stratified (40 low-overlap qwen-3 cellA + 37 high-overlap qwen-non-3 cellB + baseline strata); gemma2 parse_fail 0

cellA_lowoverlap_qwen3_n40.note: gemma2 corroborates the low-overlap tail is RELEVANT (>=2) but CONTESTS qwen's specific grade-3 (reads them as same-problem-class grade-2)

cellB_highoverlap_qwennon3_n37.note: qwen's WITHHOLDING of grade-3 on high-overlap pairs is independently confirmed

second_judge.contested_cell_agreement: n=77 combined: kappa(grade3)=0.169, exact-grade 51.9% -- the 2nd model corroborated qwen on coarse relevance but did NOT independently reproduce qwen's exact grade-3 labels on the semantic tail

human_validation.method: blind stratified operator adjudication (AskUserQuestion); qwen grade + overlap/cosine numbers hidden; pairs shuffled so order does not leak the grouping
human_validation.role: condition-2 tie-breaker -- the only INDEPENDENT signal (gemma2 had corroborated qwen on the contested cell)

cellA_lowoverlap_qwen3.non_relevant_definition: human_grade <= 1 (grade 1 = 'related topic only' is NOT a known-item/duplicate match for this dup-detection bench; 1 strict-unrelated + 3 related-only = 4/9 = ~44% spurious)
cellA_lowoverlap_qwen3.reading: qwen's low-overlap grade-3 'semantic tail' is ~44% spurious as a DUPLICATE/known-item label; the human kept it as a same-request 3 in only 2/9 and judged 4/9 non-duplicate (grade <=1). This is what DEMOTES the tail out of the primary metric.

cellB_highoverlap_qwennon3.relevance_agreement: 7/7 (every high-overlap near-dup the human judged relevant >=2)
cellB_highoverlap_qwennon3.reading: qwen's HIGH-overlap near-dup grades are RELIABLE -- human relevance-agreement 7/7. The validated near-dup signal is the primary qrels.

freeze_decision.demotion_rule: grade==3 AND jaccard_stripped < 0.3 -> excluded from primary relevant set (treated non-relevant)
freeze_decision.demotion_boundary: jaccard_stripped < 0.3 (the S14-established low-overlap boundary; a conservative cut -- the human evidence sits on the extreme low-overlap end of this band)
freeze_decision.decision_note: PRIMARY qrels = the human+gemma2-validated near-dup signal. The low-overlap grade-3 tail is DEMOTED out of the primary metric but PRESERVED append-only in the flagged sidecar for future semantic-judge research (data-steward: destroy nothing).

calibration: near-duplicate / dup-detection bench; semantic-beyond-near-dup is not reliably gradeable (human-rejected: low-overlap qwen-grade-3 ~44% spurious as a duplicate label). NOT cross-comparable to B native. The discriminating signal is near-dup detection; the demoted low-overlap semantic tail is preserved (flagged sidecar) but excluded from the primary metric.
